directions.name: Joinery
directions.mark: a bold capital A built as a furniture joint from three flat square-cut parts: two thick legs lean together and overlap at the apex, locked by one small round peg, and one straight horizontal crossbar passes through both legs and sticks out a short distance beyond the outer edge of each leg like a through tenon
directions.palette_text: near-black ink #16181D for the legs, pine green #285E4B for the crossbar, oak tan #C9A27A for the peg
directions.wordmark_desc: the word ALLIANCE in very wide extended bold grotesque capitals in ink, with AI PARTNERS beneath it in small widely letter-spaced monospaced capitals in pine green

directions.name: Counterpart
directions.mark: an upright rectangular sheet split vertically down the middle by a single zigzag cut with five sharp teeth, the two interlocking halves set slightly apart by a thin white gap, like the two matching halves of one agreement
directions.palette_text: near-black ink #17181C for the left half, seal red #A3222B for the right half
directions.wordmark_desc: the word Alliance in a classic bold book serif in ink, with AI Partners beneath it in a clean grotesque sans serif in slate gray

directions.name: Interchange
directions.mark: an abstract letter A drawn like a metro map: a thick blue line rises diagonally from the bottom left and a thick orange line rises diagonally from the bottom right, both meeting at the apex inside a single white interchange ring with a thick near-black outline, and a short thick green line forms the horizontal crossbar between them; straight segments only, flat line ends
directions.palette_text: blue #0072B2 for one line, orange #D55E00 for the other line, green #009E73 for the crossbar, near-black #111111 for the ring outline
directions.wordmark_desc: the words Alliance AI Partners in a bold highway-sign sans serif in near-black, with three thin parallel stripes in blue, green and orange beneath

directions.name: On the Level
directions.mark: a bubble level seen straight on: a long horizontal rounded rectangle outline with two short vertical marks at its center and a single round bubble resting exactly centered between the two marks, perfectly level and symmetrical
directions.palette_text: near-black ink #14181B for the outline and marks, lime #CDE03C for the bubble
directions.wordmark_desc: the words Alliance AI Partners in a modern geometric sans serif semibold in near-black, sitting on a fine horizontal baseline rule

directions.name: Backstage
directions.mark: a capital letter A made of three strips of flat stage tape: two dark strips with diagonally cut ends lean in and meet at the apex, and one short amber strip lies across them as the crossbar, like position marks taped on a stage floor
directions.palette_text: black #121212 for the two tape strips, amber #EDA531 for the crossbar strip
directions.wordmark_desc: the words Alliance AI Partners in a clean grotesque sans serif semibold in black

directions.name: Cantilever
directions.mark: a bold geometric capital A whose horizontal crossbar is a solid beam that extends straight out past the right leg into open space, cantilevered and unsupported at its far end, square ends, architectural and solid
directions.palette_text: dark steel #1B1E22 for the letter, patina green #266A60 for the beam
directions.wordmark_desc: the words Alliance AI Partners in a geometric sans serif medium weight in the style of Futura, in dark steel

directions.name: Less, but Better
directions.mark: a lowercase letter a constructed from exactly two separate geometric parts: a perfect solid circle as the bowl and a vertical rounded bar as the stem to its right, separated by a small clear gap like a control knob beside its track
directions.palette_text: charcoal #242423 for the bar, signal green #1D7A45 for the circle
directions.wordmark_desc: the word alliance in lowercase neat grotesque sans serif medium in charcoal, followed by AI Partners in a lighter graphite gray

directions.name: Relay
directions.mark: an abstract letter A made of two thick parallel diagonal strokes on a 45 degree grid, offset from each other like two runners in a relay handoff zone, with a short bar bridging the strokes as the baton, forming the crossbar; flat, modular, square ends
directions.palette_text: dark night blue #13232B for the strokes, relay green #177A4C for the baton
directions.wordmark_desc: the word alliance in lowercase semibold grotesque sans serif in dark night blue, followed by AI Partners in a lighter gray blue
